verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent tracing is observational. Its "replay" of past conversations shows transcripts and timelines, and the LLM Calls view compares recorded prompts and models. Nothing in the evidence shows a playground for editing prompts and re-running them against real models with variables. Since LLM observability products could plausibly ship a playground, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables
